text:
maria: Heads-up — PR #3246 (SDK quickstart + snippets) is blocked: docs-preview CI failed and we need a runtime confirmation on default request timeout + idempotency header behavior. Tagging @sasha and @chris. Do we document the SDK client-side timeout in the quickstart snippet or leave it unspecified?

tim: Which snippet/line is breaking the preview? Link?

maria: The JS quickstart snippet in the PR — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3246 — build shows lint passing but preview failed during metadata fetch with a `403 iam:serviceAccountToken` from the preview environment. Also the snippet currently sets `client.timeout = 30000` in the example. I think runtime default changed recently.

ci-bot: docs-preview job #512 failed: error fetching runtime metadata: permission denied (403). Logs: /builds/3246/logs/512.

sasha: Quick runtime clarification: server-side request timeout for hosted API is 120s. SDKs added a client-side safety timeout (30s in the JS SDK) last quarter to avoid stuck streams. For docs we should be explicit: mention server timeout and the SDK client default, and show how to override it for long-running prompts. Also: idempotency behavior — the server considers requests without `x-idempotency-key` non-idempotent; our JS SDK will auto-populate a UUID for retries unless a caller sets `requestId`/`idempotencyKey`. Call that out.

tim: Nice. Proposed short text for docs: "Hosted API: server timeout ~120s; JS SDK applies a 30s client-side guard by default (override via options.timeout). SDK will set `x-idempotency-key` automatically unless you provide one." Good to add?

maria: That wording looks good. But the immediate blocker is the 403 from the preview job — chris, can you look at docs-preview service account perms? We can't merge until preview passes (merge window today).

chris: Investigating — docs-preview runs with a minimal SA in the preview sandbox. Recent runtime metadata endpoint tightened permissions; docs-preview SA needs `runtime-reader` role. I can add it now (should be a quick change) and then re-run the preview. Also agree we shouldn't call the live metadata endpoint in snippets visible to the public preview; better to mock that call for preview builds.

sasha: Agree on mocking for the preview. For the canonical docs we can keep the real example and include a small migration note: "SDKs added client-side timeouts in 2025; override if needed." Once we confirm wording, runtime team can sign-off.

maria: Proposed plan: 1) update the PR to replace the live metadata fetch in the previewable snippet with a one-line mock, 2) add a short callout about server vs client timeouts and a migration note about the SDK change, 3) push and retrigger docs-preview, 4) wait for runtime sign-off, then merge during today's window. Sound good?

tim: +1. I'll push a commit with the mocked snippet and the callout now. Example mock I'll use: ```js
// preview-only: replace live token fetch with stub
const token = "PREVIEW_TOKEN_STUB"
```

maria: Thanks. @sasha @chris — can you try to confirm by EOD? If runtime confirms, we can merge in the scheduled window. I'll request reviewer re-approval after the change.

sasha: Confirmed from runtime: no server behavior change, server-side timeout stays 120s. Approve the docs wording and the preview-mock approach.

chris: Applied SA permission fix, retriggering preview job.

ci-bot: retriggered docs-preview #512 (attempt 2).

ci-bot: docs-preview #512 succeeded.

maria: Perfect — requested re-review from @tim and @sasha and left a note in the PR to wait for runtime sign-off before merge.

tim: Approved, lgtm :+1:.

sasha: Approved.

maria: Merged during today's window. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround — leaving a short post-merge follow-up task to add a short FAQ item about the client timeout change. :sparkles:
